description: Find a file's local imports, reverse imports and tests connected by imports. Each relationship includes a source path and line as evidence. Static file relationships, not runtime callers or test coverage. Scans JavaScript/TypeScript including tests, with bounded work and explicit unresolved imports and scan limits. Deterministic; no provider call.

depth.description: Import hops in each direction, default 1

directory.description: Project directory; source outside this directory is excluded

file.description: Source file, absolute or relative to directory

limit.description: Total neighboring files to return, default 50

maxFiles.description: Maximum source files to discover, default 1000

name: map_dependencies
title: Map a file's dependency neighborhood
